parameters.formDescription: Upload the saved Failure Traces CSV after human review. Choose your target in Choose Failure Category first. The workflow compares the judge with the existing main category, without showing that label to OpenAI.

parameters.content:
## Judge one main failure category with OpenAI
1. Complete human review and assign ONE main category to each failed trace.
2. Edit category, definition and contrast_rule in Choose Failure Category. Use the exact category name from the workbook.
3. Attach your OpenAI credential to Ask OpenAI. Model: gpt-5.4-mini.
4. Execute and upload Failure Traces as CSV. Include failed traces from the selected category AND other categories.
5. Download the results and inspect Calibration Summary. TRUE means the selected category is the MAIN problem; FALSE means it is not. Neither means the post passes. Errors and insufficient evidence stay unresolved.

Only the request, saved post and source facts reach OpenAI. Human labels and feedback are used for comparison afterward. Clarify the definition after inspecting disagreements, then rerun the same saved traces. Keep previous results. No new workbook tab is required.
